concert_VulnerabilitiesSummary.critical.justification: Both fields represent counts of critical severity issues.

concert_VulnerabilitiesSummary.high.justification: High severity issues can be conceptually related to MAJOR severity, as both indicate significant problems.

concert_VulnerabilitiesSummary.low.justification: Low severity vulnerabilities can be related to MINOR severity issues, as both represent less critical problems.

concert_VulnerabilitiesSummary.medium.justification: Medium severity can be conceptually linked to NORMAL severity, as both represent a middle ground in terms of issue severity.
